author: Cristina Laila
title: Democrat Attorneys General Sue Trump and Elon Musk Over DOGE
text:
• 14 Democrat state attorneys general filed a lawsuit against President Trump and Elon Musk.
• The lawsuit claims that Trump violated the Appointments Clause of the Constitution.
• The states involved include Arizona, Michigan, Rhode Island, New Mexico, and Massachusetts.
• The attorneys general argue that Elon Musk operates with 'unchecked power' as he is not Senate confirmed.
• They seek to invalidate Musk's directives and actions and request a restraining order.
• Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel stated the lawsuit aims to challenge Musk's authority.
• The White House responded, calling the lawsuit a 'continuation of the weaponization of justice' against Trump.
• White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt expressed confidence in being vindicated in court.
• The lawsuit alleges that Musk's role in DOGE is unconstitutional and has led to significant reductions in the federal workforce.
• Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes criticized the concentration of power in the hands of an unelected billionaire.
